mechanics.bridge: socket server; external clients connect, get registered (HiveMind example)
mechanics.protocol: SYNC:<sys>:ACTIVE -> heartbeat; CMD:<cmd> -> dispatched to bus; else relayed as message; every message ACKed
mechanics.lifecycle: connect/disconnect published to system.log; registry status tracked

system_role: The external-bridge pattern: how outside systems (future: Copilot, phone, kernels) join the bus. Reference for the digest-worker/KV bridge.
